churches.name: Garden Church
churches.researchSummary: Two campuses (Huntington Beach and Costa Mesa). Runs a house church network as a core structure rather than an add-on. Statement of faith NOT LOCATED — site returned HTTP 429 and was not retried.

facts.claim: Reports to the Pastor of Strategic Leadership, not the Lead Pastor. Authority over the discipleship rebuild may be real but is one layer down; worth clarifying.
Posting states an ideal schedule of Sunday through Thursday, 40-55 hours per week. The upper end is a demanding week; ask what it looks like in practice.
Statement of faith NOT LOCATED. garden.church returned HTTP 429 (rate limited) and was not retried, per the source access policy.
Two campuses: Huntington Beach (16450 E. Pacific Coast Hwy) and Costa Mesa (2599 Newport Blvd).
Michael Petrila serves as Community Life Pastor and oversees the house church network.

Supports and equips simple churches in homes, providing a network of accountability, encouragement, and local mission. Each House Church meets weekly with shared meals, worship, reading scripture, and prayer.
Stated vision: the church is not just a place to attend but a people embodying the reality of Heaven here and now.
Posting requires training and experience ministering in the power of the Spirit, indicating charismatic or continuationist practice.

opportunities.title: Associate Pastor // Discipleship and House Churches
opportunities.descriptionText: Associate Pastor over Discipleship and House Churches at Garden Church. Serve as the primary pastoral leader over the House Church network: support, pastor and care for House Church Leaders, identify and train new House Church Leaders, pastor and coach the House Church Overseers Team, visit regularly to shepherd and evaluate health, develop House Church curriculum in collaboration with the Teaching Team, oversee the strategic multiplication of House Churches, and mobilize House Churches to live on mission. Own the Discipleship Pathway: evaluate, rebuild and oversee a new assimilation/belonging/discipleship process, create a new follow up process, lead the creation of a new discipleship pathway that creates a cohesive curriculum of courses, experiences and practices, plan and lead Welcome to Church Experiences at both campuses, and plan and execute baptisms. Lead Garden Courses: planning, ideation, administration and execution; create content and train leaders to teach and facilitate; develop a digital platform for content and courses. Serve as a member of the Garden Teaching Team and be prepared to preach as scheduled at any Garden Service, School of Ministry or Event. Management: monthly one-to-ones with direct reports, build and manage yearly Ministry Plans, oversee assigned budgets and budget vs actuals, relationally invest in the lives of your team, model leading through vulnerability and prayer. Supervisor: Pastor of Strategic Leadership. Ideal work schedule Sunday through Thursday, 40-55 hours per week.
